concepts.title: Andromeda Galaxy
concepts.summary: The nearest major galaxy to the Milky Way, located about 2.5 million light-years away.
keyPoints: On a collision course with the Milky Way in 4.5 billion years

concepts.title: Quantum Entanglement
concepts.summary: A physical phenomenon where entangled particles remain connected such that actions performed on one affect the other instantly.
keyPoints: Dubbed 'spooky action at a distance' by Einstein
history: 2022: Nobel Prize awarded for experimental proof

funFacts: One day on Venus is longer than one year on Venus.
Neutron stars can spin up to 600 times per second.
There are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way galaxy.
